About this project
The Records Vault

    
A self-paced SQL dungeon built by Luis Batista, a people analytics leader with 12 years in HR data. Every puzzle runs real SQL against a fictional HR database, right here in your browser.

    
Built with Three.js for the dungeon, SQLite compiled to WebAssembly for the queries, and a lot of dry HR humor. No data leaves your device.

    
All people and companies in the vault are fictional.
